# test_lru_cache.py
import pytest

# Replace "your_module" with the module where lru_cache is defined.
from your_module import lru_cache


def test_get_missing_key_returns_minus_one():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    assert get("missing") == -1


def test_put_and_get_happy_path():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put("a", 1)
    put("b", 2)

    assert get("a") == 1
    assert get("b") == 2


def test_evicts_least_recently_used_item_when_capacity_exceeded():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put("a", 1)
    put("b", 2)
    put("c", 3)

    assert get("a") == -1
    assert get("b") == 2
    assert get("c") == 3


def test_get_updates_recently_used_order():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put("a", 1)
    put("b", 2)

    assert get("a") == 1

    put("c", 3)

    assert get("a") == 1
    assert get("b") == -1
    assert get("c") == 3


def test_put_existing_key_updates_value_and_recently_used_order():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put("a", 1)
    put("b", 2)
    put("a", 10)
    put("c", 3)

    assert get("a") == 10
    assert get("b") == -1
    assert get("c") == 3


def test_capacity_one_only_keeps_most_recent_item():
    get, put = lru_cache(1)

    put("a", 1)
    assert get("a") == 1

    put("b", 2)

    assert get("a") == -1
    assert get("b") == 2


def test_capacity_zero_does_not_store_items():
    get, put = lru_cache(0)

    put("a", 1)

    assert get("a") == -1


def test_negative_capacity_does_not_store_items():
    get, put = lru_cache(-1)

    put("a", 1)
    put("b", 2)

    assert get("a") == -1
    assert get("b") == -1


def test_independent_cache_instances_do_not_share_state():
    get1, put1 = lru_cache(2)
    get2, put2 = lru_cache(2)

    put1("a", 1)
    put2("a", 100)

    assert get1("a") == 1
    assert get2("a") == 100


def test_supports_none_as_key_and_value():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put(None, None)

    assert get(None) is None


def test_supports_minus_one_as_stored_value():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put("a", -1)

    assert get("a") == -1


def test_get_with_unhashable_key_raises_type_error():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        get(["unhashable"])


def test_put_with_unhashable_key_raises_type_error():
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        put(["unhashable"], "value")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("invalid_capacity", [None, "2", object()])
def test_invalid_capacity_type_raises_type_error_on_put(invalid_capacity):
    get, put = lru_cache(invalid_capacity)

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        put("a", 1)
